summary.intent: Add first-class support for Codex transcripts to the `entire explain --generate` command and resolve associated failures in Codex sessions.
summary.outcome: Implemented Codex-aware transcript scoping and summarization on branch `codex-explain-generate`, fixed a semantic offset bug identified in PR #875, and resolved CI linting errors.

repo: The `CheckpointTranscriptStart` metadata field represents a raw JSONL line offset across all agent types, not an agent-specific message or item index.
Codex transcripts require normalization into a compact format before they can be processed by the shared summarizer pipeline.

code.finding: The summarizer switch lacked a case for AgentTypeCodex, causing it to fall back to an incompatible Claude/Cursor parser.
ClaudeGenerator shells out to the local 'claude' CLI rather than calling the API directly, inheriting the user's local CLI configuration.
Codex format detection needed to be broadened to recognize scoped transcript suffixes that no longer contain the leading 'session_meta' line.

workflow: Static code review and unit tests can fail to catch semantic mismatches in metadata units (e.g., lines vs. items) unless validated against real-world repository state.
Subprocess execution via exec.CommandContext requires explicit timeout wrapping to prevent indefinite hangs if the child process blocks.

friction: Misleading error message 'claude CLI failed (exit -1)' when the subprocess was manually interrupted or hung.
Go build cache restrictions in the sandbox environment required repeated use of execution escalation for testing.
open_items: Implement an explicit timeout for the summarization subprocess in ClaudeGenerator.
Improve error handling to distinguish between process hangs, cancellations, and actual transcript parsing failures.
Merge PR #875 once the final push passes CI.
